Part – III BENGALURU, FRIDAY , 27, MARCH, 2026(CHAITHRA, 06, SHAKAVARSHA, 1948) No. 251

Commerce & Industries Department,
Karnataka Government Secretariat,

Vikasa Soudha, Dr. BR Ambedkar Road,

Bengaluru - 560001.

Tel. 080-22034625 Fax. 080-22353932

No. CI 97 SPQ 2025 Date:27.03.2026

NOTIFICATION-I

In exercise of the powers conferred by sub-section (1) of section 3 of the
Karnataka Special Investment Region Act, 2022 (Karnataka Act 5 of 2023), the
Government of Karnataka hereby declare that the area consisting of Baikampady
Industrial Area, Single Unit Complexes viz., KIOCL, KSSIDC, MCF, MOTIMAHAL,
PARISONS Infrastructure, JUPITER, BPCL, HPCL, MRPL, TOTAL GAS, MSEZ, BASF,
BHARAT BARREL and JESCO return land, Mangaluru Taluk, Dakshina Kannada District
with an extent of 5568.91 acres occupied by industries as shown in the map enclosed
herewith & consisting of areas specified in Schedule A to be called as “the Baikampady
Special Investment Region”.

By Order and in the name of the
Governor of Karnataka,

(NADEEM AHMED.K)
Under Secretary (ID),
Commerce & Industries Department.
(1)

NOTIFICATION-II

In exercise of the powers conferred by sub-section (1) & (3) of section 8 of the
Karnataka Special Investment Region Act, 2022 (Karnataka Act 5 of 2023), the
Government of Karnataka hereby designate Karnataka Industrial Areas Development
Board (KIADB) as the Regional Development Authority for “the Baikampady Special
Investment Region” and is empowered to exercise all the powers and perform all the
functions as specified under Section15 of the said Act.

By Order and in the name of the
Governor of Karnataka,

(NADEEM AHMED.K)
Under Secretary (ID),
Commerce & Industries Department.
Commerce & Industries Department,

NOTIFICATION-III

Whereas, the Government of Karnataka has declared Baikampady Industrial
Area, Single Unit Complexes viz., KIOCL, KSSIDC, MCF, MOTIMAHAL, PARISONS
Infrastructure, JUPITER, BPCL, HPCL, MRPL, TOTAL GAS, MSEZ, BASF, BHARAT BARREL
and JESCO return land, Mangaluru Taluk, Dakshina Kannada District as “the
Baikampady Special Investment Region” published vide Notification-I, No. CI 97 SPQ
2025, dated 25.03.2026 as required under sub-section (1) of section 3 of the Karnataka
Special Investment Region Act, 2022 (Karnataka Act 5 of 2023).

R.N.I. No. KARBIL/2001/47147 POSTAL REGN. No. RNP/KA/BGS/2202/2017-19
Licensed to post without prepayment WPP No. 297
Whereas, the Government of Karnataka has designated Karnataka Industrial
Areas Development Board (KIADB) as the Regional Development Authority for
Baikampady Special Investment Region published vide Notification-II, No. CI 97 SPQ
2025, dated 25.03.2026 as required under sub-section (1) & (3) of section 8 of the
Karnataka Special Investment Region Act, 2022 (Karnataka Act 5 of 2023).
Now, therefore in exercise of the powers conferred under Sub Section (1) of
Section 29 of the Karnataka Special Investment Region Act, 2022 (Karnataka Act 5 of
2023), “the Baikampady Special Investment Region” shall deemed to be an Industrial
Township and the Government of Karnataka hereby declare that the Karnataka
Industrial Areas Development Board (Regional Development Authority) to be the
Industrial Township Authority.
Also, the Government of Karnataka hereby accord permission to exercise powers
and discharge functions of Industrial Township Authority by the Regional Development
Authority under sub-section (2) & (3) of section 29 of said Act.

By Order and in the name of the
Governor of Karnataka,

(NADEEM AHMED.K)
Under Secretary (ID),
Commerce & Industries Department.
